# Graphics and materials

`game.graphics` changes how things and pawns look: textures, colors, shaders, pawn bodies, hair and heads, extra render layers. `game.materials` creates materials, sets their properties and loads shaders from asset bundles. The kits are Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md).

Textures live in a mod's `Textures` folder and are named without the extension. `set_def_graphic` swaps the texture of a thing def and redraws the things on the map. `add_render_node` adds a texture layer to every pawn of a race through the 1.6 render tree. A custom shader comes from an asset bundle in the mod folder (`load_bundle`) and is then used by name in `set_def_graphic`, `materials.create` and overlays.

```lua
game.graphics.set_def_graphic("Steel", "MyMod/Steel", { color = "#aabbcc" })
game.graphics.set_hair_color(colonist, "#ff4400")
game.graphics.set_body_type(colonist, "Fat")

local shaders = game.materials.load_bundle("my.mod", "Bundles/glow")
local mat = game.materials.create(shaders[1], { texture = "MyMod/Glow", color = "#44ccff" })
```

Animation: `play_animation` plays a vanilla animation def on a pawn where the game version has pawn animations, and raises `RK3003` otherwise.

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.graphics.texture_info` | `path` | `RimTextureInfo` | Whether a texture exists in a mod's Textures folder and how big it is. |
| `game.graphics.set_def_graphic` | `def, texture, opts?` | `boolean` | Replaces the texture, colour, size or shader of a thing def and refreshes the things on the map. |
| `game.graphics.body_types` |  | `string[]` | Body type defs. |
| `game.graphics.hairs` |  | `string[]` | Hair defs. |
| `game.graphics.head_types` |  | `string[]` | Head type defs. |
| `game.graphics.add_render_node` | `race, id, texture, opts?` | `boolean` | Adds a texture layer to every pawn of a race through the render tree. |
| `game.graphics.set_color` | `thing, color` | `boolean` | Colours a thing (items, apparel, buildings that allow colouring). |
| `game.graphics.refresh` | `thing` | `boolean` | Redraws a thing or pawn. |
| `game.graphics.set_body_type` | `thing, def` | `boolean` | Sets a pawn's body type and redraws it. |
| `game.graphics.set_hair` | `thing, def` | `boolean` | Sets a pawn's hair. |
| `game.graphics.set_hair_color` | `thing, color` | `boolean` | Sets a pawn's hair colour. |
| `game.graphics.set_skin_color` | `thing, color` | `boolean` | Overrides a pawn's skin colour. |
| `game.graphics.set_head_type` | `thing, def` | `boolean` | Sets a pawn's head type. |
| `game.graphics.play_animation` | `thing, def` | `boolean` | Plays an animation def on a pawn, where the game version supports it. |
| `game.materials.shaders` |  | `string[]` | Shader names you can use: the game's own and those from loaded bundles. |
| `game.materials.create` | `shader, opts?` | `integer` | Creates a material and returns its id. |
| `game.materials.set_color` | `id, color, property?` | `boolean` | Sets a colour property, _Color by default. |
| `game.materials.set_float` | `id, property, value` | `boolean` | Sets a float property. |
| `game.materials.set_texture` | `id, path, property?` | `boolean` | Sets a texture property, _MainTex by default. |
| `game.materials.info` | `id` | `RimMaterialInfo` | Shader, colour and texture of a material. |
| `game.materials.destroy` | `id` | `boolean` | Frees a material. |
| `game.materials.load_bundle` | `package_id, path` | `string[]` | Loads an asset bundle from the mod folder and registers its shaders. Returns their names. |
